title: Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Mapato)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child turns an m- noun with a one-syllable root into its small form with kiji- (mto -> kijito) and gives it KI-VI agreement.
representations: a small and a huge drawing
steps: Add kiji- to a one-syllable root.
contexts: a tiny child in a story

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mji mdogo sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "jiji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Udogo wa nomino hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji. Ukubwa hutumia ji-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mto mdogo sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "mto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kuonyesha udogo, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mto-kijito.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Miti midogo sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "kijiti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa udogo hutumia vi-: vijiti, vijito, vijiji, vijitu.
Nomino ya udogo huchukua upatanisho wa KI-VI: kijito kimejaa.
